name: Casteller

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Trentino denomination spread over dozens of communes, from Riva del Garda to Trento and Rovereto. Its rules require at least 50% Merlot, with only Lagrein, Teroldego, Lambrusco A Foglia Frastagliata and two Schiava types allowed for the rest.
